summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam. The jersey carries title partners Groupama and FDJ United (on the chest); launch coverage (velopack, 3bikes) names only the team name on the jersey and Bioracer as the new kit maker. All other companies listed on the club's partners page are recorded here as 'partner'; the sponsor list follows that page in full, but on-shirt placements (sleeve, back, shorts) could not be verified from open text sources.
